responsibility: C/C++ interface header between the GCC-side glue code and the language-independent Go frontend proper. It declares the argument block used to create the frontend IR state (`go_create_gogo_args`), entry points for parsing files, emitting globals, enabling dumps/optimizations, and adding search paths, plus the GCC-provided callbacks for GC preservation, identifier localization, alignment queries, unsafe-import handling, and Go export-data I/O, making it the central contract header shared by `go-lang.cc`, `go-backend.cc`, and the Go frontend library.
